text: {"reconstruction":4,"feasibility":3,"rationale":"The proposal gets the overall procedure and step order right, but it is too vague to automate reliably: it never says to read the browser's version from the support table, it makes the MDN URL an input when it should be found during the run, it uses a recipient email instead of the customer name needed for the greeting, it says \"Discard/finish\" instead of saying not to send, and it leaves out closing the MDN tab."}

data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall procedure and step order right, but it is too vague to automate reliably: it never says to read the browser's version from the support table, it makes the MDN URL an input when it should be found during the run, it uses a recipient email instead of the customer name needed for the greeting, it says "Discard/finish" instead of saying not to send, and it leaves out closing the MDN tab.
